LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 SENTENCES: SIMPLE SENTENCES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do you determine what to include in a sentence?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify simple sentences from varied texts,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. construct simple sentences on a variety of issues,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the importance of using a variety of sentences in communication. ● Learners are guided to listen keenly to a poem or a story on land travel and write down all the simple sentences that feature in the texts. ● Learners are guided to read a print or non-print text on land travel and identify the simple sentences. ● Learners are guided to tell a chain story featuring simple sentences. ● Learners with low vision are guided to complete a substitution table while learners with blindness complete exercises 1. How do you determine what to include in a sentence? 142 featuring simple sentences. ● Learners are guided to complete a mind map to practise the construction of simple sentences. ● Learners are guided to write a short dialogue using simple sentences and share it with peers online and offline.
